reason: Reviewed the Experian plc Annual Report 2015 (50K char excerpt covering business lines, strategy, operations across 39 countries, and financials). The company describes itself as 'the world's leading information services company' serving Credit Services, Decision Analytics, Marketing Services, and Consumer Services across North America, Latin America, UK/Ireland, and EMEA/Asia Pacific. However, no Total Addressable Market figures are disclosed in this filing. The document focuses on operational metrics (e.g., 890m people, 103m businesses under management, 3.8m daily credit reports) and financial KPIs (revenue growth, EBIT margin, ROCE) but does not quantify the TAM for any segment or geography.
